narr: Training thunderstorms on the afternoon of August 3rd produced flash flooding and debris flows across southern Colorado. Parts of central and western Fremont County received several inches of rain in short order causing flash flooding and road closures.
ev: Fremont county sheriff reported a rock slide on highway 50 at mile marker 261.
Picture shared from emergency manager showing water rushing over roadway at location.
lsr: FREMONT COUNTY SHERIFF REPORTED A ROCK SLIDE ON HIGHWAY 50 AT MILE MARKER 261.
